title: Relation Between PRST Score, Skin Conductance and BIS
brief_summary: Determine the relation between PRST (pressure, rate, sweating, tears) score, skin conductance (SC) and Bispectral index (BIS) values during anesthesia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Minor elective surgery
* General anaesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* autonomic neuropathy
* presence of a pacemaker
* medication with anticholinergic drugs
* use of ketamine, clonidine
